[EN] I'm so sorry, Zolyn! I just didn't want you to rush in and get hurt...like you always do...
[ES] ¡Lo siento mucho, Zolyn! Solo no quería que te apresuraras y salieras lastimado... como siempre lo haces...

[EN] Take me with you! I'll stay out of your way.
[ES] ¡Llévame contigo! No estorbaré.
